universal_checks: nonclassical top boundary and special first-row diagonal term
dimension_range: 1<=d<=(N-1)/2, N odd; irreducibility is an exponent-bound proof
consequence: All interior singular centres at odd order have a simple of dimension < N. Complete H3 iff (D-Dplus)(D-Dminus)!=0.
scope: Universal symbolic recurrence identities, not finite parameter sampling; maximal-order, terminal boundary and McKay are ordinary proofs.
